request.text: Before doing anything else, tell Leo that he gets to choose tonight's bedtime story. After you say that, blink twice, then look at him for three seconds.

responsibilities.outcome: Tell Leo that he may choose tonight's bedtime story before either requested body action occurs.
After the message to Leo, blink exactly twice before looking at him.
After the message and two blinks, look at Leo for three seconds.

semantic_facts: The plan should first communicate to Leo that he may choose tonight's bedtime story, then blink exactly twice, then look at Leo for three seconds.
All three Responsibility scopes and the full speech-to-blink-to-gaze order should remain explicit in the mixed result.
forbidden_claims: The plan begins either body action before the message, overlaps or reverses the ordered Activities, or omits one Responsibility.
The assistant claims the body actions already happened or adds walking, weather, or reminder work.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A mixed communicative-and-embodied sequence loses its cross-mode ordering when Activities are materialized.
The planner treats a natural conjunction as permission to merge, reorder, or omit independently satisfiable outcomes.
